testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/checkout/verify-simple-product-checkout-page-coupon-and-voucher-code-functionality-for-retail-user.spec.ts > Webstore - Checkout > verify simple product checkout page coupon and voucher code functionality for retail user

scenario.summary: A registered user signs in, adds a simple product at quantity 5 and reaches checkout with the flat-rate shipping method, removes the auto-applied voucher, applies a voucher and checks Amount To Be Paid, checks that an invalid voucher and an invalid coupon are rejected, applies an Amount Off Order coupon and checks the order-total reconciliation, then pays with Vantiv Express, checks the receipt and logs out.
steps: Sign in with username/password, add simpleProduct at quantity productQuantity, open the cart and proceed to checkout
Select the flat-rate shipping method and remove the auto-applied voucher
Apply voucherNumber: number, labels and order total - voucher amount = amount to be paid (0.05); remove it
Apply invalidVoucher and check invalidVoucherMessage; apply invalidCoupon and check invalidCouponMessage; remove it
Apply coupon: success message, discount line, Handling Charges label, order-summary reconciliation (0.05)
Fill projectName and additional information, pay with Vantiv Express (masked card), check the receipt banner and job name, log out
stateChanges: Registered user cart: product added, voucher removed and re-applied then removed, coupon applied
An order is placed with the coupon (one coupon redemption consumed); the voucher is removed before payment, so its balance is not spent
assertions: Applied voucher number equals voucherNumber; Voucher Amount and Amount To Be Paid labels
Order total - voucher amount - amount to be paid within 0.05
Invalid voucher message equals invalidVoucherMessage; invalid coupon message equals invalidCouponMessage
Coupon message equals couponSuccessMessage; discount visible; Handling Charges label; reconciliation within 0.05
Thank-you banner visible; job name equals projectName
evidence: Title matches the flow (retail user, simple product, coupon and voucher, order placed)
Credentials (masked) name the existing registered user: USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED with preferred.required true (credential source).

DOUBT: proceedFromCart goes straight to shipping, so the account must already have a default shipping/billing address; USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED does not constrain that (same gap as the other retail checkout entries).
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store every atstage webstore spec runs on (same as the approved shopping-cart and PDP entries); not named in the scan.
Profile (atstage, generated 2026-10-31T17:34) has no observations for this spec (scanned 2026-11-01): every source is profiled false.

checkoutPage.selectShippingMethod clicks Ship Complete and then lblShippingMethodFLAT (Custom Flat Rate): SHIPPING_FLAT_RATE_ON_STORE with shippingCode FLAT; destination country assumed 'us'; assumption.
Spec carries a MAINTENANCE NOTE: last run 2026-09-18 failed on the Vantiv Express payment modal (build mismatch); evidence only.
simpleProduct at productQuantity 5: PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK quantityUsed 5, minMaxQuantity 5. z-1002656 and the voucher number also appear in spec comments only.

coupon TESTCHECKOUT (live, read-only: promotion Testim_CheckoutPageCoupon, Amount Off Order, Discount 10, OrderMinimum 10, no profile, store PortalId 7, AvailableQuantity 100): COUPON_AMOUNT_OFF_ORDER discountAmount 10 (amount not asserted), allProfiles true, allowedWithOtherCoupons false, redemptionsNeeded 1 (the order consumes one redemption).

Re-mapped (voucher keys 2026-11-01): voucherNumber JDL4WZ9XYS -> need voucher (VOUCHER_RESTRICTED_TO_USER), output voucherNumber, preferred (the test's own voucher first); read-only: applied and removed, no order placed with it

Ownership gap: the voucher must be the one restricted to the declared account. A declared account (preferred required) cannot be linked to (validator), so VOUCHER_RESTRICTED_TO_USER has no user param: the test's own voucher is tried first (preferred, bound to this account in the data); a fallback voucher is restricted to SOME customer, not necessarily this one. Enforcing it needs the planned core feature 'record owned by the declared account' (as for saved carts and reorder)
invalidVoucher and invalidCoupon are deliberately non-existent codes: config (they must stay absent from the store).

Missing key: the Vantiv Express credit-card payment method associated with MaxwellsHardware and shown at webstore checkout (payWithVantivExpress). PAYMENT_COD_ON_STORE covers COD only; the need is left out. Card values are masked test-gateway settings: config.
